hero.eyebrow: Secret Santa for family and friends
hero.title: Secret Santa, sorted with one link
hero.lead: Start a Secret Santa, share the link with your family or friends and let everyone join. Givto draws the names, keeps the wishlists and counts down to gift day.
hero.note: Free. No passwords, no app to install.

create.title: Start a Secret Santa
create.description: Give it a name, and add a gift day and a budget if you like. Takes a minute.

share.title: Share one link
share.description: Share the link with your family or friends. You don't need anyone's email address.

join.title: Everyone joins
join.description: People tap the link, enter their name and email and confirm with a code we send them.

draw.title: Draw names
draw.description: Once everyone's in, draw names. Everyone only sees their own giftee, and you can keep couples apart.

wishlists.title: Fill your wishlists
wishlists.description: Add a few wishes so your Santa knows what to get you. Santas call Dibs! so nobody buys the same thing twice.

gift-day.title: Gift day
gift-day.description: Unwrap in turns with the unwrap order, and end with the big reveal if you want one.

wishlist.title: One wishlist, every group
wishlist.description: Keep one personal wishlist and use it in all your groups. Hide wishes from a group that shouldn't see them.

dibs.title: Dibs!
dibs.description: Santas claim a wish so nobody doubles up. You never see what's been claimed on your own list.

tips.title: Tips for Santa
tips.description: Know what someone really wants? Leave a tip for their Santa, with your name or anonymously.

editions.title: Same again next year
editions.description: Your group sticks around. Next year, start a new edition with everyone ticked, and the draw avoids last year's pairs.

account.question: Does everyone need an account?
account.answer: No passwords and nothing to install. People join from the link with their name and email and confirm with a code we email them.

secret.question: Who can see who drew whom?
secret.answer: Everyone only sees who they give to. If you like, end gift day with the big reveal.

apart.question: Can I keep couples apart?
apart.answer: Yes. Put them in the same Keep apart row and they never draw each other.

cost.question: What does it cost?
cost.answer: Nothing. Givto is free and open source.

data.question: What happens to my data?
data.answer: We only keep what your Secret Santa needs and clean up after gift day. Read the <link>privacy page</link>.
